description: Paste prose — an article, a paragraph, anything — and it is sung. An LLM picks a phrase from the text that fits the scene, composes 1-6 vocal lines over the scene's key and chords, and each syllable is spoken by a system speech voice and forced onto its note (WORLD analysis/resynthesis: the speaker's mouth is kept, their intonation discarded). Harmony styles from unison and choral to organum and cluster; delivery as unison, canon or hocket; voice characters built from formant warp, breath and pitch jitter. Rendering is offline — every voice lands on its own audio track, so freeze and export behave normally.
